CompletionText.SourceString: Viktor was surprised. He swore he never brewed Doll’s Tears and that his seal couldn’t be forged easily. He mentioned learning his methods from the old Alchemists' academies, but claimed their obsession destroyed them. He suspects someone is imitating his mark, or something worse. He told me to check Sorwynn’s shrine by the cliffs, where offerings are sometimes… change hands.
